target.title: improve(ui): nest Settings pages under /settings routes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Control UI Settings pages currently live at several top-level URLs, so Settings navigation does not have a single canonical URL namespace. This proposes `/settings/*` as the canonical Settings route family while preserving existing top-level deep links.

## Why This Change Was Made

Settings route metadata now points navigation and programmatic route generation at `/settings/general`, `/settings/appearance`, and the rest of the `/settings/*` pages. Existing top-level paths such as `/config`, `/appearance`, `/channels`, `/debug`, and `/logs` remain registered as aliases so old links still resolve to the same route ids.

This intentionally does not change Settings layout, sidebar structure, visual styling, form placement, or content organization.

## User Impact

Users get canonical Settings URLs under `/settings/*`; existing bookmarks and direct links to the older top-level Settings paths continue to work.

## Evidence

Validated locally:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts ui/src/app-navigation-groups.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 ui/src/app-route-paths.ts ui/src/pages/config/route.ts ui/src/pages/channels/route.ts ui/src/pages/debug/route.ts ui/src/pages/logs/route.ts ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts ui/src/app-navigation-groups.test.ts`
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD`
- Route resolver smoke: `/settings/general -> config`, `/settings/appearance -> appearance`, `/appearance -> appearance`

Skipped by request: local `codex /review` and autoreview.
